Sign in to your Claude plan
  Claude Code's own sign-in runs below. Approve it in your browser and, if it
  asks, paste the code it shows. As the screen passes, this client hides
  anything shaped like the token Claude Code makes, keeps it in memory and sends
  it to KeepState once. It cannot hide a token it does not recognise, and when
  it is not sure it read the token whole it keeps nothing.

Sign in to your Claude plan
  Claude Code is not installed on this computer. On a computer that has Claude
  Code, run claude setup-token, sign in there, and paste the token it prints
  here. Nothing is shown as you paste.


! This client could not read the token safely
  It was hidden and not kept because a line break or a screen code may have cut
  it. Run claude setup-token yourself, in another terminal, and paste the token
  it prints.
